title_en: apartment for sale 3+1+2+Verande, Cabej buildings, 195,000 euros
description_en: apartment for sale in the area of ​​izberishti, pallatet cabej, the apartment is organized in a distribution corridor, the living room together with the dining room, the cooking room is separate together with a balcony, and a toilet, there are 3 bedrooms, where the couple's room has a bathroom with a bathtub and a wardrobe inside the room, there is a super large veranda where one part is isolated and one part is open. it is all furnished, with a kitchen complete with all electrical appliances, there is air conditioning in every room and windows with shutters, it is oriented east-south with a lot of light and sun, the property has regular mortgage documentation, the price is 195,000 euros, non-negotiable.
